toxic_note.en: Poisonous in all parts: contains cardiac glycosides that can cause serious heart problems.
toxic_note.ro: Otrăvitoare în toate părțile: conține glicozide cardiace care pot provoca probleme grave ale inimii.

note.en: The leaves can be mistaken for each other. Confusing them has caused serious poisonings.
note.ro: Frunzele pot fi confundate. Confuzia a provocat intoxicații grave.
